title: Physics objects and meshes are leaking if instantiated from a PackedScene created at runtime
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1], v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e].

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8183) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 15.34 GiB memory

### Issue description

If you pack a scene at runtime and then instantiate it, after closing the game you'll see errors like this
```
ERROR: 2 RID allocations of type 'P11GodotBody3D' were leaked at exit.
ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'P12GodotShape3D' were leaked at exit.
ERROR: Pages in use exist at exit in PagedAllocator: N33RendererSceneRenderImplementation22RenderForwardClustered32GeometryInstanceForwardClusteredE
   at: ~PagedAllocator (./core/templates/paged_allocator.h:169)
ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'N10RendererRD11MeshStorage4MeshE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: Leaked instance dependency: Bug - did not call instance_notify_deleted when freeing.
```
Or this if you use Jolt
```
ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'P11JoltShape3D' were leaked at exit.
ERROR: 2 RID allocations of type 'P10JoltBody3D' were leaked at exit.
```
Errors about MeshStorage and renderer are not always but often present.
```
ERROR: Pages in use exist at exit in PagedAllocator: N33RendererSceneRenderImplementation22RenderForwardClustered32GeometryInstanceForwardClusteredE
   at: ~PagedAllocator (./core/templates/paged_allocator.h:169)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Have a scene with a `Node3D` with an instantiated scene child. The child scene should must contain a `MeshInstance3D` as a root node and a child `StaticBody3D` with a collision shape.
2. In your main scene write a script that packs the `Node3D` into a `PackedScene` and then instantiates it.
3. Run the game and close it. There will be errors in a terminal (should run Godot from a terminal to see the output from the game).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[physics_objects_leak_2026-03-11_12-06-26.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25896299/physics_objects_leak_2026-03-11_12-06-26.zip)
